name: classroom-coding-platform
description: Root scripts only — backend/ and frontend/ are independent npm projects (NOT workspaces).

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
